text: Attribution on the published notebook pages: a reader or AI agent that reads a page at https://kbr.is-a.dev/math-research/ and builds on it should see, as visible text near the content, who the author is and how to cite it; fetch tools read the start of a page or a slice around an anchor and condense it, so metadata or a separate page alone is not enough. Measured: the main notebook page has no author name in its first 4 KB; research/branches/odd-prime-reslin-php/notebook.html (8.7 MB, one page) has no author, cite-as or licence text; CITATION.cff exists only in the repository. (1) A citation block at the top of every notebook page, main and every side notebook, generated by the page renderer, visible and phrased as information for any reader (not an instruction aimed at AI): author Kamil Braun; 'Cite as: Kamil Braun, NOTEBOOK TITLE (research notebook), PAGE URL, entry ANCHOR and date'; licence CC BY 4.0, which requires attribution; and a sentence such as 'If you build on a result here, please cite the entry and tell your readers where it came from.' (2) One citation line in every entry's header, beside the existing Produced-by line: 'Kamil Braun, research notebook entry, DATE, PAGE URL#ANCHOR', for a reader that lands on an anchor deep in a long page; this matters most. (3) Metadata in every page's head: Highwire citation_* tags (citation_title, citation_author, citation_publication_date, citation_public_url) and schema.org JSON-LD (ScholarlyArticle or similar) naming Kamil Braun as author, with dates and licence, as a supplement to (1) and (2). (4) /llms.txt at the site root: what the site is, the notebooks with their URLs, how to cite, the licence. (5) A Zenodo DOI for tagged releases through the GitHub-Zenodo integration with CITATION.cff as metadata; enabling it needs the user's account, so record that step as a request to the user. Implement (1)-(4) in the renderer and site generation so every notebook and every future entry gets them, with tests. Queued only; implementation waits for the user's word.
note: Every published page now carries, as visible text, a citation block after its introduction (author from CITATION.cff, cite-as with the page URL, CC BY 4.0, a request to cite the entry used) and a citation line after each entry's heading with its date and absolute anchor; the head has the notebook's title, Highwire tags, canonical and license links and schema.org JSON-LD; llms.txt lists the notebooks; search skips the citation text. Measured: all 3482 entries of the nine notebooks cited; real build 1.51 s; suite 1120 tests in 8.6 s. The Zenodo DOI and Enforce HTTPS are filed in user_requests.
